description: This file defines a logging utility class for Android, providing static methods to send log messages to configured LogNodes, as well as constants for log levels.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class that provides static methods for logging messages and managing LogNode chains.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head LogNode for logging.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode where log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends a log message to the LogNode chain, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert-level message with optional Throwable.
